fixed.summary: An edit made in the same timestamp tick as the cook before it (4 ms on ext4, up to 2 s on FAT) that kept the file's length left its size and times as they were, so the next cook, and og cook --watch and og dev's reload, reused the old result. A source or cooked file last written in the tick a cook saw it in is now compared by content on the next cook. Cooked bytes are unchanged; a .og/cook-index written by an earlier version is rebuilt on the first cook.
